map.连作障碍指数（土壤病原菌积累）估算 使用指南: Continuous-cropping obstacle index (soil pathogen accumulation) estimation user guide
map.基于连作年限与病原菌年增长率，估算土壤病原菌积累程度与连作障碍风险等级: Estimate soil pathogen accumulation and continuous-cropping obstacle risk level based on continuous-cropping years and annual pathogen growth rate
map.当前病原菌密度 = 初始密度 × (1 + 年增长率%)^连作年限；连作障碍指数: Current pathogen density = initial density x (1 + annual growth rate%)^continuous-cropping years; continuous-cropping obstacle index = current density / threshold density x 100
map.病原菌随连作年限按复利式累积：初始密度乘 (1 + 年增长率) 的年限次幂。以阈: Pathogens accumulate compoundly with continuous-cropping years: initial density times (1 + annual growth rate) to the power of years. The obstacle index is converted against threshold density (current / threshold x 100), with accumulation multiple (current / initial). Index < 30 safe, 30-60 warning, > 60 severe; advise regular monitoring, rotation/soil disinfection, and rotation with bio-fumigation or resistant varieties respectively.
map.综合连作年数、前茬寄主一致性、土传病害史评分。: Score by combining continuous-cropping years, previous-crop host consistency and soil-borne disease history.
map.指数高提示自毒与病原基数累积。: High index suggests autotoxicity and pathogen base accumulation.
map.：连作 5 年、年年同科、枯萎病史阳性，三项加权得指数 75/100。建议下茬嫁: : 5 years continuous cropping, same family every year, positive wilt history, three items weighted give index 75/100. Suggest grafting next crop onto black-seed pumpkin rootstock (wilt-resistant) and summer solarization 20 days, or fallow with onion/garlic to suppress nematodes.
map.病原菌积累为什么难发现？: Why is pathogen accumulation hard to detect?
map.多存在于土壤与残体，地表看不出，发病才显症且已晚。靠连作年限与前茬记录预判比靠肉: Mostly in soil and residues, invisible on the surface; symptoms appear only when disease strikes and it is already late. Predicting by continuous-cropping years and previous-crop records is more reliable than the naked eye.
map.盛夏灌透水、覆透明膜密闭 2~4 周，利用积温杀灭表层病原与杂草种子。成本低的物: In midsummer flood-irrigate, cover with clear film sealed for 2-4 weeks, using accumulated heat to kill surface pathogens and weed seeds. A low-cost physical method, but depends on the hot season.
